title: A pane that can disappear without a user action must hand its focus on first
rule: When a pane, panel or column can be removed by a state the user did not aim at it (a window resize, a fold by room, a timer, a store refresh), watch that state with flush: 'pre' and, when the pane is about to go and it contains document.activeElement, move the focus to a stable neighbour (the main column) before the v-if removes it. Otherwise the focus falls to body and the next Tab restarts at the top of the page. Test it with Playwright: focus the pane, trigger the change (setViewportSize), assert the neighbour is focused, and check the test fails without the watcher.
rationale: E58.6 (#717): the library sidebar folded by itself on a resize and its v-if removed the focused nav, so the keyboard focus fell to document.body.
